best_human.source: Leech (1956), On the representation of 1,2,...,n by differences; Golay (1972), Notes on the representation of 1,2,...,n by differences. Reported in Banakh and Gavrylkiv (2017), Theorem 4.1 and Table 3, and Georgiev et al. (2025), arXiv:2511.02864v1, §6.3.
best_human.evidence_state: The historical human source reports a 128-mark feasible construction. Its exact original point list was not recovered. A separately reconstructed Singer/Leech-family 128-point witness is saved and exactly verified; it is not claimed to be the identical historical construction.
best_human.ai_provenance: The Leech and Golay sources predate modern LLM-based generative AI. No AI use is reported for this historical construction.
best_human.origin_type: source-reported human construction; exact original witness not recovered

best_public.source: Leech (1956) and Golay (1972), recorded in Banakh and Gavrylkiv (2017), Theorem 4.1/Table 3; also Georgiev et al. (2025), arXiv:2511.02864v1, §6.3.
best_public.evidence_state: The cited literature reports a feasible 128-mark construction. Our separately reconstructed 128-mark witness is exactly checked, but is not claimed to be the original historical list.
best_public.ai_provenance: The Leech and Golay sources are traditional human mathematics and predate modern LLM-based generative AI. The AlphaEvolve paper separately reports an AI-assisted improvement at N=49109. AI involvement in the historical N=6166 construction is not indicated.
best_public.origin_type: published human upper bound; exact historical witness not recovered

best_reproduced.verification_method: Exact integer difference scan over the generated Singer/Leech-family set; verify all 6166 distances.
best_reproduced.origin_type: independent reconstruction, not asserted to be the source authors' original witness

highest_reported.source: Leech-Golay construction as cited by Banakh and Gavrylkiv and by Georgiev et al.
highest_reported.reproduction_status: An independent Singer/Leech-family construction of the same cardinality is saved and exactly verified. The original historical witness list is not claimed to have been recovered.

other_parameter_results.source: Georgiev et al. (2025), arXiv:2511.02864v1, §6.3 and its AlphaEvolve repository notebook.
other_parameter_results.ai_provenance: AlphaEvolve was given code for Singer-set construction by human researchers; the paper describes this as an AI-assisted improvement.
other_parameter_results.evidence_state: Different N and an asymptotic-constant record; not substituted for the N=6166 record.

compatibility_score.note: H is the separately recorded 158-mark Wichmann W(38,3) frozen human baseline; 128 is the source-reported strongest human construction.

optimality_status.analytic_lower_bound: Banakh and Gavrylkiv (2017), Theorem 4.1: lim Delta(n)^2/n = inf Delta(n)^2/n >= 2 + max_{0<phi<pi} 2 sin(phi)/(phi+pi). At phi=pi/2 this is >= 2+4/(3*pi) > 80/33 because pi<22/7. Therefore 33*Delta(6166)^2 > 80*6166 = 493280. Since 122^2*33=491172<493280 and 123^2*33=499257>493280, Delta(6166)>=123.
optimality_status.counting_lower_bound: The simpler pair-count bound is k(k-1)/2 >= 6166 and implies k >= 112; the analytic lower bound 123 is stronger.
optimality_status.upper_bound: An exact 128-mark witness is saved and checked.
optimality_status.limitation: No exact value was found in the checked paper, cited classical sources, or current AlphaEvolve problem repository. This is a bounded source survey, not a proof that no later result exists.

frozen_human_baseline.source: Wichmann (1963), reconstructed as W(38,3); completeness formula and proof in Saarela and Vanhatalo (2026), Definitions 8 and 16 and Theorem 18.
frozen_human_baseline.evidence_state: The 158-mark Wichmann construction has length 6548 and is exactly checked for every required distance 1..6166. This weaker baseline is distinct from the source-reported best human record of 128.
frozen_human_baseline.origin_type: published human construction; restricted ruler is a feasible unrestricted integer difference basis
